data.notes: May 2026 is dominated by Ischgl’s winter-season finale, with the Top of the Mountain concert and local closing parties before the valley shifts into quieter off-season programming.

events.title: Kitzloch Closing
events.summary: Two-day season-closing party directly in front of Kitzloch, with Draufgänger on May 1 and Junge Zillertaler on May 2. The event is listed as free admission and starts at 16:00 on both days.

events.title: Rebel Tell at Idalp
events.summary: Rebel Tell play Idalp at 13:00 with their “Schlagerbilly” blend of Schlager, rock’n’roll energy and party covers. The official listing states regular ski-pass rates apply and there are no additional ticket sales.

events.title: Top of the Mountain Closing Concert with Christina Aguilera
events.summary: Christina Aguilera headlines Ischgl’s flagship Top of the Mountain Closing Concert at Idalp at 13:00. The show closes the Silvretta Arena Samnaun/Ischgl winter season with a major international pop headliner.

events.title: Hallenfest FF Mathon
events.summary: Local fire-brigade hall festival in Mathon, near Ischgl, with a Saturday disco evening starting at 20:00 and a Sunday morning pint from 11:00. The official listing confirms the two-day schedule for May 30–31, 2026.
